stages.name: Germination
stages.irrigation: Light irrigation immediately after sowing. Avoid waterlogging.
stages.fertilizer: Apply full basal dose: 60 kg DAP + 30 kg MOP per acre before sowing.
watch_for: Poor germination due to dry soil
tips: Soil moisture is critical at this stage

stages.name: Crown Root Initiation (CRI)
stages.description: First critical irrigation stage. Roots establish.
stages.irrigation: First irrigation (CRI irrigation) at 20–21 days after sowing. This is the most critical irrigation.
stages.fertilizer: Apply first split of Urea: 30 kg per acre with CRI irrigation.
tips: Do not miss CRI irrigation — skipping it reduces yield by 20–30%

stages.name: Tillering
stages.description: Side shoots (tillers) develop. Crop establishes canopy.
stages.irrigation: Second irrigation at 40–45 days after sowing.
stages.fertilizer: Apply second split of Urea: 25 kg per acre with second irrigation.
tips: If aphids are seen, spray Imidacloprid 0.5 ml/litre

stages.name: Jointing / Stem Extension
stages.description: Stem elongates rapidly. Plant height increases.
stages.fertilizer: No fertilizer needed at this stage.
tips: If rust is seen, spray Propiconazole 1 ml/litre immediately
Avoid excess nitrogen — increases lodging risk

stages.name: Booting / Flag Leaf
stages.description: Flag leaf fully emerged. Head forming inside the sheath.
stages.irrigation: Fourth irrigation at 75–80 days. Critical for grain filling.
stages.fertilizer: No fertilizer. Foliar spray of 2% Urea can be beneficial.
watch_for: Loose smut disease (black powder replacing grain)
tips: Protect the flag leaf — it contributes 40% of photosynthate to grain

stages.name: Heading / Flowering
stages.description: Ear heads emerge and pollination occurs.
stages.irrigation: Fifth irrigation at 90–95 days if soil is dry.
watch_for: Karnal bunt (partial replacement of grain by black powder)
tips: Avoid irrigation during flowering — disturbs pollination
Do not apply pesticides during flowering

stages.name: Grain Filling / Dough Stage
stages.description: Grains filling with starch. Crop turns golden.
stages.irrigation: Sixth irrigation at 105–110 days only if conditions are very dry.
watch_for: Late rust attack can reduce grain weight
tips: Monitor grain moisture — harvest when 12–14% moisture

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Crop fully mature. Leaves and stems dry out.
watch_for: Shattering losses if harvest is delayed
tips: Harvest promptly once crop is ready
Thresh within 2–3 days of cutting to avoid losses

common_pests.name: Aphids
common_pests.symptoms: Colonies of small insects on leaves and stems, sticky honeydew

common_pests.name: Termites
common_pests.symptoms: Wilting plants, hollow stems at base

common_pests.name: Army worm
common_pests.symptoms: Skeletonized leaves, caterpillars visible at night

common_diseases.name: Brown Rust
common_diseases.symptoms: Orange-brown pustules randomly on leaf surface
